newsitem.title: FINLAND: Tamro sees flat 1997 sales, earnings.
newsitem.headline: Tamro sees flat 1997 sales, earnings.

text.p: Finnish pharmaceuticals wholesaler Tamro Oy said on Friday it expected its profit this year to remain at last year's levels.

"If there are no significant downtrends in the economic developments or the exchange rates were Tamro operates, the 1997 net sales and profit after financial items are expected to remain approximately at last year's levels," Tamro said in a statement with its January-April results.
It also said its target was to boost earnings per share by over 15 percent per year on average and said it aimed to reduce capital use in distribution, cut costs and boost customer satisfaction.
